stem: An analyst works out a promotion's uplift against three baselines: 30% against the pre-period, 18% against last year and 13% against control stores. The report quotes 30%, because it looks best. What is wrong?

options.text: Nothing: the highest uplift is the most cautious choice
The baseline must be chosen before looking at the results
The average of the three, about 20%, is the only fair number
Control stores can never be used to judge a promotion
